--[[
    BIG HUB V9.1 LOADER
    Press 'K' to toggle UI
]]
local _0x7f4a = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function _decode(data)
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'.._0x7f4a..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if (x == '=') then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (_0x7f4a:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d', function(x)
        return string.char(tonumber(x, 2))
    end))
end

local _payload = _decode("" .. "❌")

local _success, _err = pcall(function()
    loadstring(_payload)()
end)

if not _success then
    warn("BigHub Error: " .. tostring(_err))
end
